title: MM6 Spider
description: The original MM6 giant spider, using native B dark blue/black palette. Eight long angular tapering segmented legs, broad rounded abdomen with original plate/band markings, low dark cephalothorax, small native red eyes and mouth details. Restore the original pre-rendered fantasy game look, dark muted blue-black chitin, broad baked highlights with restrained fine detail. Preserve native leg count, joint positions, pose silhouette, body/leg proportions and head orientation. No extra eyes, spikes, furry tarantula redesign, photorealistic insect macro lighting, added web or glow.
regions: Blue-black chitin body and legs recolor into native brown and red variants. Protect small red eyes/mouth accents, neutral white fangs and dark mouth cavities. Preserve exact native blood/FX presence only where the native pose shows it.
